source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Φιλήμων και Δομνίνος»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The two share one line and one page, and the page gives each of them a heading of his own, so they are two folders. It gives no emperor and no year, so there is no dates object. The corpus keeps a Domninus of Thessalonica on 1 octombrie, arrested alone at Thessalonica while Maximian was building a palace there, and this page's parenthesis that some sources make Philemon and Domninus Thessalonians is the only thing joining the two: the day, the companion and the manner of death are all different, and no identification has been made here.
